name: Lost In The Universe
author: facundorsabia
description:
This is my first game development. It's a DEMO with 2 levels i developed for Coderhouse (Argentina) course of VideoGame development.
It is a demonstration of my skills as a developer with this engine.  I used free assets from the Unity asset store.
